design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (site_lease_rent_and_renewals, Home-Site Lease).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 6, 5]}. Assignment: late fee 6 factors, nonpayment cure period 6, down payment 5, installments 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: lease_ext_renewal_offer_rent / issue_renewal_offer_ab5c4495 and lease_ext_signed_renewal_rent / sign_lease_renewal_1699e1a4 (renewal pricing). Claimed here, disjoint: lease_ext_late_fee_assessment (post_late_fee_cfe97caa), lease_ext_nonpayment_cure_period (serve_nonpayment_notice_fb7be621), lease_ext_plan_down_payment (make_lease_payment_8919b7b0), lease_ext_plan_installments (sign_repayment_agreement_730960e3) - the arrears chain. Union of both tasks = all six extended policies; nothing is reserved.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: Marcus, short on October rent after a 400.00 partial payment, wants a payment plan signed today. Scored root: installment_amount of the repayment agreement. Hidden prerequisites: (1) the 2026-10 late fee is owed (grace ended 2026-10-08 under his 7-day long-tenure grace) and not posted; (2) a nonpayment notice is owed (rent unpaid 12 days > 10) and may not be served until that fee is on the ledger; (3) the down payment is worked out on the amount the notice demands, and the installments divide the balance left after it. Chain: late fee -> notice -> down payment -> installments, plus notice -> installments (diamond). Depth 3 hops; breadth: lease ledger (charges, payments, late fees, returns), lease notices (old notice and agreement), utility account and ledger, tenure, community, payment channel and rhythm.
[Why a good test] Four writes, two of them the resident's own (payment and signature); every value depends on the one before: fee 38.94 -> demanded 370.94 -> down payment 90.4 -> 10 installments of 28.05. An agent who skips the fee demands 332.00 (notice amount 332.0); one who skips the notice reads the stale 2024 amount 1180.00 (down payment 215.8, installment 20.04); one who signs before the payment spreads the whole demand (37.09).
[Problem-tree card] Edges: (a) lease_ext_nonpayment_cure_period <- lease_ext_late_fee_assessment, state_gate, gate lease_ledger.event_type, form state, sentence "A nonpayment notice is not served until the rent ledger carries the late fee owed for every billing period whose grace period has ended with its rent unpaid." (negated direction; 'not until'; record-visible state: the late fee owed for every period whose grace ended unpaid; only the late-fee policy writes lease_late_fee rows). (b) lease_ext_plan_down_payment <- lease_ext_nonpayment_cure_period, value_input on covered_balance, form state, sentence "When a billing period's rent is unpaid long enough for a nonpayment notice to be owed, the down payment on a repayment agreement is not worked out before the notices on the lease carry a nonpayment notice demanding that past-due balance." (negated, scoped by the 'when' clause; only the notice policy writes nonpayment notices). (c) lease_ext_plan_installments <- lease_ext_nonpayment_cure_period, value_input on covered_balance, form state, sentence "The installments of a repayment agreement are fixed only after the notices on the lease carry the nonpayment notice whose amount demanded the agreement covers." (affirmative 'only after'). (d) lease_ext_plan_installments <- lease_ext_plan_down_payment, value_input on remaining_balance, form state, sentence "Before the installments of a repayment agreement are fixed, the rent ledger must carry the down payment received on the signing date." (affirmative 'before ... must'; only the down-payment policy writes a payment on the signing date). Resolution order (unique topological order): lease_ext_late_fee_assessment, lease_ext_nonpayment_cure_period, lease_ext_plan_down_payment, lease_ext_plan_installments. Load-bearing runs: skipping step 6 changes the notice's amount_demanded from 370.94 to 332.0 and the down payment's fees; skipping step 10 changes the down payment 90.4 -> 215.8 and the installment 28.05 -> 20.04; skipping step 12 changes the installment 28.05 -> 37.09. user_scenario never mentions a fee, notice or down-payment rule; no tool checks anything.
[Base-invariant card] Late fee (lease_late_fee): grace_period_ended (time) - anchor the due date of the period's rent charge (lease_ledger.entry_date of 2a03c77d-c76f-4a0b-b7f6-526f1715c823 = 2026-10-01), base duration late_fee_grace_days; under the declared overwrite the grace is 7 days for 120+ months of tenancy, so the fee may post from 2026-10-09; posting 2026-10-13 is after it. Boundary: on 2026-10-08 (the last grace day) no fee may post; on 2026-10-09 it may. Notice (lease_nonpayment_notice): no structured gate (policy_scope): active lease, rent unpaid more than 10 days after the due date (12 days), no current repayment agreement (the 2024 agreement ended long ago). Down payment (lease_payment): lease_accepts_payments - status active; the certified-funds channel gate is retired by the declared overwrite (down payments always go through certified-funds channels; online_portal_card is one). Agreement (lease_repayment_agreement): plan_lease_active - status active; plan_tenure (time) - 6 full months from 2015-04-15 completed 2015-10-15, long satisfied; a resident who moved in 2026-04-14 would be one day short on 2026-10-13. Trailing-12-month agreement limit 1: none in 12 months. Arrears cap 2 x 702.00 = 1404.00 >= 370.94.
[Business-object card] Lease 61af5ba5-677c-411a-b085-8172b06efc71, billing period 2026-10, rent charge 2a03c77d-c76f-4a0b-b7f6-526f1715c823 and occupant charge c3ba46a9-4b46-46ad-9aec-6dd88171238d; included: the 2026-10-12 400.00 payment 6c136222-2d04-4218-9f6e-11c4ebe7eb09 (after grace, so not deducted from the unpaid amount but counted as a partial payment); excluded: all earlier periods (fully paid, each by two portal payments on the 1st and 5th), the 2025-09 late fee and the 2024-08 NSF cluster (outside the windows), the 2024-01 notice and agreement (stale; outside 24 months).
[Factor card: late fee, step 6, expected 38.94, baseline_result 36.6] first_lapse_rate (parameter: late fees in trailing 12 months = 0 (the 2025-09-07 fee 3ad98b14-6022-448a-8f91-23735496bdd5 is 13 months back) -> first_late_pct 4.5 percent of the unpaid 732.00 = 32.94; baseline gives 42.6) | tenure_grace_length (parameter: 137 full months since 2015-04-15 (>= 120) -> 7-day grace, last grace day 2026-10-08; the 2026-10-12 payment is after it; baseline gives 42.94) | standing_floor (parameter, multi-source: 137 months AND no returned payment in trailing 24 months (the 2024-08-05 return 7dbfe3df-c17c-4688-8617-a574f78ce913 is 26 months back) -> floor 25.00, so the percentage fee 32.94 stands; baseline gives 41.0) | paid_share_daily_charge (parameter: the latest payment on or after the due date is 400.00, at least half of 732.00 -> daily charge 2.00; baseline gives 41.94) | accrual_end_anchor (method: the latest payment (2026-10-12) came after the last grace day -> days accrue 2026-10-09..2026-10-11 = 3 days; baseline gives 42.94) | community_accrual_method (method, multi-source: site at Cedar Hollow AND the period's charges 732.00 still exceed the latest payment on or after the due date (400.00) -> percentage fee plus daily charge: 32.94 + 2.00 x 3 = 38.94; baseline gives 32.94) | unpaid (plumbing): period charges 702.00 + 30.00 = 732.00, no payment inside the grace period, balance at the end of grace 332.00 + 400.00 = 732.00 -> 732.00 | result: MN(38.94, late_fee_maximum 75.00) = 38.94
[Factor card: notice cure period, step 10, expected 20, baseline_result 7] tenure_extension (parameter: 137 months >= 120 -> +3 days; baseline gives 16) | first_notice_extension (parameter: nonpayment notices in trailing 24 months = 0 (the 2024-01-15 notice 7aebc06a-f927-4cb8-9c1d-fb32e9e863d9 is 33 months back) -> +3 days; baseline gives 16) | partial_payment_extension (parameter: latest payment 400.00 on 2026-10-12, at least half of 732.00 -> +2 days; baseline gives 17) | steady_payer_extension (parameter: 23 payments received in the trailing 12 months (>= 12) -> +2 days; baseline gives 17) | utility_standing_extension (parameter, cross-difficulty utility, multi-source: no utility late fee in 12 months (2025-06-24 fee ec2adc33-1006-47dc-ab72-d59584a75106 outside) AND utility balance 0.00 -> +2 days; baseline gives 17) | payment_channel_calendar (method: latest payment through online_portal_card -> calendar days with weekend roll; 7 + 12 = 19 days from Tuesday 2026-10-13 ends Sunday 2026-11-01 -> moved to Monday 2026-11-02 = 20 days; baseline gives 19) | community_days (plumbing): Cedar Hollow 7 | result: 20 days (cure deadline 2026-11-02)
[Factor card: down payment, step 12, expected 90.4, baseline_result 92.74] standing_down_percentage (parameter, multi-source: 137 months AND no repayment agreement in trailing 24 months (the 2024-01-19 agreement db4e113f-004c-4086-80d2-574940d3a07a is 32 months back) -> 20.0 percent; baseline gives 107.0) | fees_up_front_method (method: no returned-payment fee within the past month, the 2026-10 late fee 38.94 posted at step 6 -> that late fee in full, percentage on the rest 370.94 - 38.94 = 332.00; baseline gives 57.5) | partial_payment_credit (parameter: latest payment 400.00 >= half of 732.00 -> -2.0 points; baseline gives 97.04) | prompt_arrangement_credit (parameter: 12 days after the 2026-10-01 due date (<= 15) -> -1.0 point; baseline gives 93.72) | first_lapse_credit (parameter: late fees in trailing 12 months for earlier periods = 1 - 1 = 0 -> -1.5 points; baseline gives 95.38) | covered_balance (plumbing, the notice's value): amount demanded by the 2026-10-13 notice = 370.94 | result: 38.94 + RND(332.00 x 15.5 / 100) = 38.94 + 51.46 = 90.4
[Factor card: installments, step 14, expected 28.05, baseline_result 93.51] covered_size_plan_length (method: covered 370.94 <= 0.6 x 702.00 = 421.20 -> plan months counted from the dollars owed, one per 200.00 or part thereof: 2 plan months; baseline gives 23.38) | tenure_added_months (parameter: 137 months >= 120 -> +2 plan months; baseline gives 46.76) | utility_standing_months (parameter, cross-difficulty utility, multi-source: no utility late fee in 12 months AND balance 0.00 -> +1 plan month; baseline gives 35.07) | payment_rhythm_schedule (parameter: 12 payments in the trailing 6 months (9..19) -> twice-monthly, 2 installments per plan month; baseline gives 56.11) | remaining_balance (plumbing, the down payment's value): lease balance after step 12 = 280.54 | result: 280.54 / (5 x 2) = 28.05 over 10 installments
[Overrides] Late fee: base fee sentence and grace counting sentence (lease_evt_late_fee). Notice: base amount/deadline sentence (lease_nonpayment_process). Down payment: partial-payment refusal and certified-funds sentences (lease_evt_payment_acceptance) and the down/installment sentence (lease_repayment_terms). Installments: the down/installment sentence (lease_repayment_terms) and the cure sentence (lease_nonpayment_process). Every deviation is declared clause by clause.
[Seed rationale] 14 months of charges and split portal payments, all settled before grace (no late fee since 2025-09); the October partial payment; the 2024 NSF cluster and 2024 notice/agreement as excluded near-misses; utility account current with an old (2025-06-24) late fee outside the window. Automatic clauses: the late fee and the notice are owed (both carried by this task); no certified-funds restriction (one fee-bearing return, 26 months ago); no autopay.
[Persona] Plain-spoken warehouse lead; volunteers the goal and the 400.00 partial payment; mentions paying today (debit card, portal, up to about 150) only after the agent says something must be paid today he made (ledger row 6c136222-2d04-4218-9f6e-11c4ebe7eb09); identity on request; pays the stated amount himself by debit card through the portal (online_portal_card) and signs the agreement himself; never quotes a balance or fee; closes when the agreement is signed.
[Reachability] All writes at 2026-10-13 10:15 EDT; every number is computable from the ledger, notices, utility records and published rules; the payment confirmation number is returned by the resident's own tool call.
[Standard solution] find_customers, verify, lease, ledger, notices -> post late fee 38.94 on 2026-10 (source 2a03c77d-c76f-4a0b-b7f6-526f1715c823) -> utility account and ledger -> serve notice demanding 370.94 with 20 cure days -> hand over payment: 90.4 via online_portal_card -> hand over agreement: covered 370.94, 10 installments of 28.05, first due 2026-11-01.
[Verification run] authoring sim with the real tools: late fee 38.94 (factor baselines {'first_lapse_rate': 42.6, 'tenure_grace_length': 42.94, 'standing_floor': 41.0, 'paid_share_daily_charge': 41.94, 'accrual_end_anchor': 42.94, 'community_accrual_method': 32.94}, all-baseline 36.6); cure days 20 ({'tenure_extension': 16, 'first_notice_extension': 16, 'partial_payment_extension': 17, 'steady_payer_extension': 17, 'utility_standing_extension': 17, 'payment_channel_calendar': 19}, 7); down payment 90.4 ({'standing_down_percentage': 107.0, 'fees_up_front_method': 57.5, 'partial_payment_credit': 97.04, 'prompt_arrangement_credit': 93.72, 'first_lapse_credit': 95.38}, 92.74); installment 28.05 ({'covered_size_plan_length': 23.38, 'tenure_added_months': 46.76, 'utility_standing_months': 35.07, 'payment_rhythm_schedule': 56.11}, 93.51). Per-task gates green (see final report).
[Draft recomputation from visible context] Fee: 4.5% of 732.00 = 32.94 (floor 25.00), +2.00 x 3 days = 38.94; notice: balance 370.94, 7+3+3+2+2+2 = 19 days ending Sunday -> 20; down: 38.94 + 15.5% of 332.00 = 90.40; plan: 2+2+1 = 5 months, twice monthly -> 10 installments of 280.54/10 = 28.05. Agrees with gold.
[Revision round 2 - policy-task audit] F2 (payment_rhythm_schedule labelled method but only substituted k in 4/2/1) -> relabelled parameter, and covered_size_plan_length became the installment computation's genuine method: plan months are counted from the dollars owed (one per 200.00 or part) for small balances, from the rent owed (one per half month's rent or part) for large balances, or fixed at payment_plan_max_installments otherwise. F3 (community_accrual_method's second condition held for every posting) -> the condition is now that the period's charges still exceed the latest payment received on or after the due date, which fails for a resident who paid in full after grace but before posting (that resident gets the percentage fee alone). C1 -> the cure policy declares its overwrite of the base calendar-day counting sentence and keeps 'a payment received on the deadline day itself is in time'. C3 -> late-fee rule sentence 1 now assesses the period of the most recent rent charge, as compute does. C4 -> the office business-day count starts from the following Monday when the notice date is a Saturday or Sunday (checked against a brute-force business-day counter for every weekday and 1..39 days). O3 -> the installment rule states that the covered balance is the amount demanded by the most recent nonpayment notice. O4/G2 -> all roundings are half up (epsilon before RND); down-payment baseline now 92.74. P1 -> the persona mentions paying by debit card only after the agent says something must be paid today. Re-run: fee 38.94, cure 20, down payment 90.4, 10 installments of 28.05; skip runs 332.0 / 215.8 / 20.04 / 37.09. Gates re-run green (final report).
[Revision round 3 - policy-task audit] N1 (symptom: the late-fee rule let an earlier period's fee be assessed only while that period's rent charge was the most recent one, while the cure rule waits on 'the late fee owed for every billing period whose grace period has ended with its rent unpaid'; root cause: the rule never said what becomes of a fee that was not assessed in time, so 'owed' had two readings - an unassessable but owed fee blocking every notice, or a lapsed fee) -> late-fee rule sentence 1 now ends 'and a late fee not assessed by the time the next rent charge falls due lapses and is no longer owed', so the cure gate counts only fees that can still be assessed: the fee of the most recent rent charge's period once its grace has ended. The cure prerequisite sentence, every compute, every scored value and every factor figure are unchanged; on this world October is both the most recent charge and the only period unpaid past grace, so the edge reads as before (no 2026-10 fee at the opening, posted at step 6). Gates re-run green.
[Revision round 4 - policy-task audit] N2 (symptom: after the round-3 lapse clause, the cure edge's declared condition still demanded a late-fee row for every period unpaid at grace end, lapsed fees included, so it was stronger than its prerequisite sentence; root cause: the condition field was not updated with the rule) -> the condition, in the charter's prerequisite entry and verbatim in prerequisite_closure.edges[0], now reads 'lease_ledger holds a lease_late_fee row for every billing period whose rent and occupant charges were unpaid at the end of the last grace day and whose late fee is still owed, that is, has not lapsed because the next rent charge fell due before it was assessed.'. The prerequisite sentence, the rules, every compute, every scored value and every factor figure are unchanged; on this world no fee has lapsed (October is the most recent charge, its fee owed and assessable; 2025-09 already carries its fee), so the edge is unmet at the opening exactly as before and flips at step 6.
user_scenario: You are Marcus T. Ellison, forty-six, a shift lead at a distribution warehouse outside Grand Rapids, and you have lived on site E-162 at Cedar Hollow since April 2015 with your wife, your grown son and your teenage daughter. Your hours were cut in September, and yesterday you could only put $400 toward October's lot rent, which you paid on the resident portal with your debit card. You call the Hearthstone resident desk sounding a little embarrassed but straightforward, and you open with: "I'm behind on October's lot rent and I want to set up a payment plan for the rest of it today." You give your phone number, 616-555-0113, so they can find your account. When the agent asks you to verify, you give your date of birth, 1979-11-02, and only if they still need something, the last four of your Social Security number, 1186. You want the plan set up and signed on this call. You are fine with the agent recording whatever the office has to put on your account to set the plan up, and when the agent explains that something has to be recorded first you say you understand and to go ahead. Only when the agent tells you that something has to be paid today do you say you can pay by debit card through the resident portal, up to about $150; when the agent then tells you the amount and hands you the payment, you pay exactly that amount yourself with your debit card and read back the confirmation number if asked. Only if the agent asks how you usually pay do you explain that you pay through the portal, normally in two pieces each month, one on the first and the rest by the fifth when your second paycheck lands. You do not know the balance to the cent and you ask the agent to go by what is on the account; you never quote any fee or total yourself. When the agent hands you the repayment agreement, you sign it yourself with the amounts, number of installments and first due date the agent gives you. Once the agent confirms the agreement is signed, you say thanks, that this takes a weight off, and hang up.
